delegated.when: Any arithmetic or mathematical expression requiring an exact numeric result.
Looking for conceptually related content in uploaded documents.

delegated.capability: literal string / identifier / number / regex search
delegated.when: Searching for a known exact string, code, identifier, or numeric value in documents.
A specific element_id is known and the full artifact content is needed.
Enumerating images, tables, or other artifacts in a document, especially when RAG may not surface them.
Actual image content must be read, transcribed, or visually analyzed.

delegated.capability: code generation, debugging, refactoring, or translation
delegated.when: Substantial coding work is required that benefits from a dedicated coding model.
Retrieving recent decisions, temporary instructions, or task context specific to the current session.
Retrieving durable user preferences, long-term project facts, or cross-session knowledge.
Saving temporary context, intermediate task findings, or ephemeral instructions for the current session.
Saving durable facts, permanent user preferences, or project-level decisions that must survive across sessions.
Modifying an existing memory to reflect changed user preferences or avoid contradiction.
Explicitly forgetting or removing an outdated or invalid memory.
Consolidating a sequence of recent hot memories into a single concise summary.

delegated.capability: promote hot memory to cold memory
delegated.when: Promoting an established session fact or decision to long-term cross-session storage.

not_available: any tool not listed in tools.json
